title: Flow Selection Bounds Align
description: Add bounding rectangle to flow display with alignment buttons on top (left align, vertical equal spacing, right align) and right side (top align, horizontal equal spacing, bottom align).
summary: Moved selection align/distribute button hit regions outside the bounding rectangle: top row above, right column to the right, distribute vertical on the left edge, distribute horizontal on the bottom edge. Added overflow-visible on FlowCanvas container so outside buttons are not clipped. Updated tests to assert outside placement.
